question: A 31-year-old female receives a kidney transplant for autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD). Three weeks later, the patient experiences acute, T-cell mediated rejection of the allograft and is given sirolimus. Which of the following are side effects of this medication?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Sirolimus -> inhibits T-cell activation -> 80% CHAIN: Sirolimus -> used as an immunosuppressant -> 90% CHAIN: Sirolimus -> side effects include nephrotoxicity -> 70% CHAIN: Sirolimus -> side effects include hyperlipidemia -> 60% CHAIN: Sirolimus -> side effects include thrombocytopenia -> 80%
analysis: Sirolimus is an mTOR inhibitor commonly used in transplant patients. The side effects of sirolimus include hyperlipidemia and thrombocytopenia.
